name: JNJ Complete Auto Repair
hook: Your customers in Orland Park book by appointment and have just followed you to the new shop on 70th Court — they could be booking the next visit from their phone, at the new address, any time of day. Take a look:
fakt: you've been running JNJ as a family shop with ASE-certified technicians, servicing import, domestic and fleet vehicles by appointment Tuesday to Saturday, and you opened the new location at 15650 S 70th Court in August
na_stronie: your name and phone, your eight services in your own words (brakes, oil change, tune-up, transmission, radiator, electrical, battery, air filter), online booking in your hours — Tuesday to Saturday — and a contact form; every request lands straight in your inbox
dlaczego: With a bigger shop and appointment-only service, a booking page that works at 9 pm from a phone fills the calendar without a call — and a site at the right address is what people see when they search you by name.
